I am an old woman farming alone here in Tigray, and barley is what we know — it grows well in our cool highlands even when the rains are short. I will use a little DAP if the cooperative brings it on time, but I cannot afford much, and I will put manure from my ox and small animals on the plot like I always do. The seed I will save from last year's harvest as my mother taught me; improved seed is hard to find here and costs money I do not have. I will weed by hand with my daughter-in-law, and if the work is heavy at harvest I may call a neighbor for a day or two and pay with grain.
